title: Q-RULE-closed-loops-closedloop: standing rule closed-loops violated (closedloop)
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass (rules --run --due)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation closedloop --check
**Status:** open

RULES-1: the standing rule `closed-loops` is violated: Every open item has an owner, a trigger and a closing probe; every loop closes itself (CLOSED-LOOP-1, SERVER-OWNS-LOOPS-1).
Probe `closedloop` says: Q-RULE-gap-pages-audit: status '' is not open, closed or done

Fix the cause in code so the probe passes; the tick re-runs it every pass. Never weaken the probe or the registry.
